description: The file defines the HomeController class within the OrangeHRM installer module. It handles redirection logic during the installation process, directing to either the main application or a welcome page based on installation status.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A controller responsible for handling requests related to the installer homepage, including redirecting based on installation status.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests to the home route during installation, redirecting users accordingly.
